costs.execution: historical execution approximation where book-level history is unavailable

distinct_from_prior: Distinct from V6 trend-conflict (target sign opposing up/down trend), H2 dispersion, H3 weak-score, H4 flow, H6/H7 volatility sizing, and H8 execution fragility. This is a flat-state incremental-exposure reliability rule.
evaluation_rule: Exactly one access to the remaining chronological 30% of each outer fold. No post-access retuning. Promotion requires candidate net > baseline and >0; candidate Sharpe > baseline; max drawdown <= baseline + 0.01; wrong-side economic damage reduced; >=2/3 folds improve net; 20bps net >=0; +1h-delay net >=0.
exact_feature_definition: Use inherited causal trend_state. Trigger iff trend_state == "flat" at decision time; no future/outcome field is an input.
exact_model_or_rule_change: When trigger is true, apply the existing V7 incremental exposure scaler with scale=0.5 to new/increased H12 exposure only. Reductions and exits pass unchanged. Never reverse H12 direction.
failure_condition: Any mandatory evaluation rule failure => REJECTED_INNER and no candidate freeze; trial 870 is not rerun or rescued.
mechanism: H12 continuation reliability is weaker when the inherited causal trend state is flat; reduce only incremental exposure rather than changing direction or forcing exits.
parameter_selection_rule: On the chronological 70% selection partition within each outer fold, compare scales {0.0,0.5,0.75}. First maximize folds with positive net delta vs baseline; require candidate net >0 at 20bps and +1h delay in every selection fold; among survivors maximize mean selection net delta. This prospectively selects 0.5.
selection_rule: Chronological first 70% of each existing outer fold; candidate discovery and scale choice are confined to this partition.
target_failure: WRONG_SIDE_ECONOMIC_DAMAGE / unreliable H12 exposure increases in weak-trend state
training_rule: No V10 refit of H12. Reuse the inherited H12 decisions and causal state. V10 adds one reliability mapping only.
